paragraphs.text: A Blackthorn Castle
paragraphs.translation: A 黑刺李城堡

paragraphs.text: This famous, historically accurate, reconstructed castle and village enables visitors to travel back in time. Explore the grounds and experience the atmosphere of an ancient lifestyle. In the fields you can see the type of sheep that the original inhabitants of the castle probably kept. Homemade snacks are on sale.
paragraphs.translation:
这座著名的、在历史上精确还原的、重建的城堡与村庄能让游客穿越时空。
探索这片土地，体验古老生活方式的氛围。
在田野里，你可以看到城堡原住民可能饲养的绵羊品种。
现场出售自制小吃。
这座著名且历史还原度极高的重建城堡与村庄，让游客得以穿越时空。
探索这片土地，体验古老生活方式的气息。
在田野中，你可以看到城堡原住民可能饲养的那种绵羊。
现场有自制小吃出售。

paragraphs.text: B Withney Wetland Centre
paragraphs.translation: B 威特尼湿地中心

paragraphs.text: Visitors will enjoy a visit to Withney whatever the season. In winter, for example, they can watch from the centrally heated observatory as thousands of swans feed on the water. Trained wardens give informative talks or lead guided walks round the site. The visitors' centre may also be hired for private or corporate events.
paragraphs.translation:
无论什么季节，游客都能在威特尼享受一次愉快的参观。
例如在冬季，他们可以从中央供暖的观察台观看成千上万只天鹅在水面上觅食。
训练有素的管理员会进行内容丰富的讲解，或带领游客在场地内进行有导游的步行参观。
游客中心也可租用于私人或企业活动。

paragraphs.text: C Headley Hall
paragraphs.translation: C 黑德利庄园

paragraphs.text: Headley Hall is a large seventeenth-century country house, preserved as it was when it was built. Take time to admire the various works of art displayed, and visit the huge kitchen complete with period equipment - demonstrations are given at weekends. In the park there is space for the younger visitors to run around, and picnic tables are available.
paragraphs.translation:
您可以花时间欣赏展出的各种艺术品，并参观配有时代设备的巨大厨房——周末会有现场演示。
公园内有供年轻游客奔跑的空间，并且提供野餐桌。
黑德利大厅是一座建于17世纪的大型乡间别墅，自建成以来一直保持着原貌。
花些时间欣赏陈列的各种艺术作品，并参观配备有时代设备的大型厨房——周末会有示范表演。

paragraphs.text: D Lewis House
paragraphs.translation: D 刘易斯故居

paragraphs.text: Lewis House is the birthplace of Frank Lewis, a renowned painter of the eighteenth century. More of his works are on display here than anywhere else in the world. Visitors can see Lewis's studio and some of the articles he used on a daily basis.
paragraphs.translation:
刘易斯故居是18世纪著名画家弗兰克·刘易斯的出生地。
这里展出的他的作品比世界上任何其他地方都多。
游客可以参观刘易斯的工作室以及他日常使用的一些物品。

paragraphs.text: E Canford Wildlife Centre
paragraphs.translation: E 坎福德野生动物中心

paragraphs.text: At Canford we have a new walk-through exhibit called Island Magic. Here visitors can observe many species from the tropical island of Madagascar and read about some of the urgent conservation projects that are taking place there to save endangered species from extinction.
paragraphs.translation:
在坎福德，我们有一个名为“岛屿魔法”的新步行式展览。
在这里，游客可以观察来自热带岛屿马达加斯加的众多物种，并了解那里正在进行的一些紧急保护项目，这些项目旨在拯救濒危物种免于灭绝。

paragraphs.text: F Oakwell Museum
paragraphs.translation: F 奥克韦尔博物馆

paragraphs.text: This is an ideal venue for families. They can visit the childhood gallery with its large playroom, and listen to stories told by actors dressed in the costumes of a hundred years ago. They can also enjoy the popular games and wooden animals of that period.
paragraphs.translation:
这是一个适合家庭出游的理想场所。
他们可以参观设有大型游戏室的童年画廊，并聆听穿着百年前服饰的演员讲述故事。
他们还可以欣赏到那个时期流行的游戏和木制动物。

paragraphs.text: Paragliding in Australia
paragraphs.translation: 澳大利亚滑翔伞运动

paragraphs.text: What is paragliding?
paragraphs.translation: 什么是滑翔伞运动？

paragraphs.text: Paragliding is a kind of flying, but instead of the wing being made of metal, wood or plastic, it is made of nylon or polyester. The wing (known as a canopy) is attached to a harness by lines, not dissimilar to a parachute. The harness is where the pilots sit - and they report that it outperforms a parachute in terms of comfort.
paragraphs.translation:
滑翔伞是一种飞行方式，但它的翼面并非由金属、木材或塑料制成，而是由尼龙或聚酯纤维制成。
翼面（称为伞翼）通过绳索连接到座带上，与降落伞颇为相似。
座带是飞行员坐的位置——他们报告称，它在舒适度方面优于降落伞。

paragraphs.text: Is it safe?
paragraphs.translation: 这安全吗？

paragraphs.text: Like sailing and deep-sea diving, paragliding is as safe as the person doing it. The big advantage is that it's probably the slowest form of aviation, so if you do crash you'll hit the ground quite gently!
paragraphs.translation:
像帆船运动和深海潜水一样，滑翔伞运动的安全性取决于操作者本身。
其巨大优势在于它可能是最慢速的飞行形式，因此即便发生坠毁，你也会相当轻柔地撞击地面！

paragraphs.text: Where do I learn?
paragraphs.translation: 问题：我在哪里可以学习？

paragraphs.text: There are lots of schools, mainly based inland by appropriate hills or mountains, and there are also schools on the coast near spectacular cliffs. These are very attractive, though the prospect of landing in the sea seems to dissuade beginners! All schools will show you within a couple of days how to inflate the canopy, launch and land. They use radio instruction, tandem flying practice and schoolroom theory sessions to help you get the most from paragliding. It takes about seven days to get your basic licence; then you're free to fly independently at sites across Australia.
paragraphs.translation:
有许多学校，主要位于内陆的合适山丘或山脉附近，也有一些学校坐落在壮观悬崖附近的海岸上。
这些学校非常吸引人，尽管降落在海中的前景似乎会让初学者望而却步！
所有学校都会在几天内教你如何给伞翼充气、起飞和降落。
他们利用无线电指导、双人飞行练习和课堂理论课程，帮助你从滑翔伞运动中收获最多。
大约需要七天时间才能获得基础执照；之后你就可以在澳大利亚各地的场地自由独立飞行。

paragraphs.text: What do I need?
paragraphs.translation: 我需要什么？

paragraphs.text: Pilots normally wear warm clothes, in case they get very high up, and a helmet in case they stumble on landing. In terms of gear, schools supply basic training, canopies, harnesses, etc. However, you'll probably want to buy your own more sophisticated equipment, which you'll be able to choose much better once you've tried some out on your course.
paragraphs.translation:
飞行员通常会穿着保暖衣物，以防飞至高空时受寒，并佩戴头盔以防降落时摔倒。
至于装备，学校会提供基础培训、伞翼、背带系统等。
然而，你可能会想购买自己更精良的装备，而在课程中试用过一些设备后，你将能更明智地进行选择。

paragraphs.text: Who can do it?
paragraphs.translation: 谁可以参与这项活动？

paragraphs.text: There's no upper age limit provided your instructor deems you capable, but the youngest anybody can paraglide is 14. Anybody with good eyesight and good balance is a potential paraglider pilot. It's a very relaxed sport as you're mostly sitting down. You'll probably experience pain in some muscles you didn't know you had whilst learning, but many of those will be due to the walk up the training hill to launch. Flying a paraglider is a great sport. We hope to see you in the air with us this season!
paragraphs.translation:
只要你的教练认为你能够胜任，就没有年龄上限，但滑翔伞运动的最低年龄是14岁。
任何拥有良好视力和良好平衡感的人都有可能成为滑翔伞飞行员。
这是一项非常轻松的运动，因为你大部分时间都是坐着的。
在学习过程中，你可能会感到一些你从未意识到的肌肉疼痛，但其中很多疼痛是由于步行上山前往发射点所致。
驾驶滑翔伞是一项很棒的运动。
我们期待在这个季节看到你和我们一起翱翔天际！

sentence_translations.sentence: 1. Headley Hall is a large seventeenth-century country house, preserved as it was when it was built.
sentence_translations.translation: 1. 黑德利庄园是一座建于17世纪的大型乡间别墅，其保存状态与建造时完全一致。

sentence_translations.sentence: Take time to admire the various works of art displayed, and visit the huge kitchen complete with period equipment - demonstrations are given at weekends.
sentence_translations.translation: 您可以花时间欣赏展出的各种艺术品，并参观配有时代设备的巨大厨房——周末会有现场演示。

sentence_translations.sentence: In the park there is space for the younger visitors to run around, and picnic tables are available.
sentence_translations.translation: 公园内有供年轻游客奔跑的空间，并且提供野餐桌。

sentence_translations.sentence: Headley Hall is a large seventeenth-century country house, preserved as it was when it was built.
sentence_translations.translation: 黑德利大厅是一座建于17世纪的大型乡间别墅，自建成以来一直保持着原貌。

sentence_translations.sentence: Take time to admire the various works of art displayed, and visit the huge kitchen complete with period equipment - demonstrations are given at weekends.
sentence_translations.translation: 花些时间欣赏陈列的各种艺术作品，并参观配备有时代设备的大型厨房——周末会有示范表演。

sentence_translations.sentence: In the park there is space for the younger visitors to run around, and picnic tables are available.
sentence_translations.translation: 公园内有供年轻游客奔跑的空间，并且提供野餐桌。

sentence_translations.sentence: D Lewis House
sentence_translations.translation: D 刘易斯故居

sentence_translations.sentence: Lewis House is the birthplace of Frank Lewis, a renowned painter of the eighteenth century.
sentence_translations.translation: 刘易斯故居是18世纪著名画家弗兰克·刘易斯的出生地。

sentence_translations.sentence: More of his works are on display here than anywhere else in the world.
sentence_translations.translation: 这里展出的他的作品比世界上任何其他地方都多。

sentence_translations.sentence: Visitors can see Lewis's studio and some of the articles he used on a daily basis.
sentence_translations.translation: 游客可以参观刘易斯的工作室以及他日常使用的一些物品。

sentence_translations.sentence: E Canford Wildlife Centre
sentence_translations.translation: E 坎福德野生动物中心

sentence_translations.sentence: At Canford we have a new walk-through exhibit called Island Magic.
sentence_translations.translation: 在坎福德，我们有一个名为“岛屿魔法”的新步行式展览。

sentence_translations.sentence: Here visitors can observe many species from the tropical island of Madagascar and read about some of the urgent conservation projects that are taking place there to save endangered species from extinction.
sentence_translations.translation: 在这里，游客可以观察来自热带岛屿马达加斯加的众多物种，并了解那里正在进行的一些紧急保护项目，这些项目旨在拯救濒危物种免于灭绝。

sentence_translations.sentence: F Oakwell Museum
sentence_translations.translation: F 奥克韦尔博物馆

sentence_translations.sentence: This is an ideal venue for families.
sentence_translations.translation: 这是一个适合家庭出游的理想场所。

sentence_translations.sentence: They can visit the childhood gallery with its large playroom, and listen to stories told by actors dressed in the costumes of a hundred years ago.
sentence_translations.translation: 他们可以参观设有大型游戏室的童年画廊，并聆听穿着百年前服饰的演员讲述故事。

sentence_translations.sentence: They can also enjoy the popular games and wooden animals of that period.
sentence_translations.translation: 他们还可以欣赏到那个时期流行的游戏和木制动物。

sentence_translations.sentence: Paragliding in Australia
sentence_translations.translation: 澳大利亚滑翔伞运动

sentence_translations.sentence: What is paragliding?
sentence_translations.translation: 什么是滑翔伞运动？

sentence_translations.sentence: Paragliding is a kind of flying, but instead of the wing being made of metal, wood or plastic, it is made of nylon or polyester.
sentence_translations.translation: 滑翔伞是一种飞行方式，但它的翼面并非由金属、木材或塑料制成，而是由尼龙或聚酯纤维制成。

sentence_translations.sentence: The wing (known as a canopy) is attached to a harness by lines, not dissimilar to a parachute.
sentence_translations.translation: 翼面（称为伞翼）通过绳索连接到座带上，与降落伞颇为相似。

sentence_translations.sentence: The harness is where the pilots sit - and they report that it outperforms a parachute in terms of comfort.
sentence_translations.translation: 座带是飞行员坐的位置——他们报告称，它在舒适度方面优于降落伞。

sentence_translations.sentence: Is it safe?
sentence_translations.translation: 这安全吗？

sentence_translations.sentence: Like sailing and deep-sea diving, paragliding is as safe as the person doing it.
sentence_translations.translation: 像帆船运动和深海潜水一样，滑翔伞运动的安全性取决于操作者本身。

sentence_translations.sentence: The big advantage is that it's probably the slowest form of aviation, so if you do crash you'll hit the ground quite gently!
sentence_translations.translation: 其巨大优势在于它可能是最慢速的飞行形式，因此即便发生坠毁，你也会相当轻柔地撞击地面！

sentence_translations.sentence: Where do I learn?
sentence_translations.translation: 问题：我在哪里可以学习？

sentence_translations.sentence: There are lots of schools, mainly based inland by appropriate hills or mountains, and there are also schools on the coast near spectacular cliffs.
sentence_translations.translation: 有许多学校，主要位于内陆的合适山丘或山脉附近，也有一些学校坐落在壮观悬崖附近的海岸上。

sentence_translations.sentence: These are very attractive, though the prospect of landing in the sea seems to dissuade beginners!
sentence_translations.translation: 这些学校非常吸引人，尽管降落在海中的前景似乎会让初学者望而却步！

sentence_translations.sentence: All schools will show you within a couple of days how to inflate the canopy, launch and land.
sentence_translations.translation: 所有学校都会在几天内教你如何给伞翼充气、起飞和降落。

sentence_translations.sentence: They use radio instruction, tandem flying practice and schoolroom theory sessions to help you get the most from paragliding.
sentence_translations.translation: 他们利用无线电指导、双人飞行练习和课堂理论课程，帮助你从滑翔伞运动中收获最多。

sentence_translations.sentence: It takes about seven days to get your basic licence; then you're free to fly independently at sites across Australia.
sentence_translations.translation: 大约需要七天时间才能获得基础执照；之后你就可以在澳大利亚各地的场地自由独立飞行。

sentence_translations.sentence: What do I need?
sentence_translations.translation: 我需要什么？

sentence_translations.sentence: Pilots normally wear warm clothes, in case they get very high up, and a helmet in case they stumble on landing.
sentence_translations.translation: 飞行员通常会穿着保暖衣物，以防飞至高空时受寒，并佩戴头盔以防降落时摔倒。

sentence_translations.sentence: In terms of gear, schools supply basic training, canopies, harnesses, etc.
sentence_translations.translation: 至于装备，学校会提供基础培训、伞翼、背带系统等。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, you'll probably want to buy your own more sophisticated equipment, which you'll be able to choose much better once you've tried some out on your course.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，你可能会想购买自己更精良的装备，而在课程中试用过一些设备后，你将能更明智地进行选择。

sentence_translations.sentence: Who can do it?
sentence_translations.translation: 谁可以参与这项活动？

sentence_translations.sentence: There's no upper age limit provided your instructor deems you capable, but the youngest anybody can paraglide is 14.
sentence_translations.translation: 只要你的教练认为你能够胜任，就没有年龄上限，但滑翔伞运动的最低年龄是14岁。

sentence_translations.sentence: Anybody with good eyesight and good balance is a potential paraglider pilot.
sentence_translations.translation: 任何拥有良好视力和良好平衡感的人都有可能成为滑翔伞飞行员。

sentence_translations.sentence: It's a very relaxed sport as you're mostly sitting down.
sentence_translations.translation: 这是一项非常轻松的运动，因为你大部分时间都是坐着的。

sentence_translations.sentence: You'll probably experience pain in some muscles you didn't know you had whilst learning, but many of those will be due to the walk up the training hill to launch.
sentence_translations.translation: 在学习过程中，你可能会感到一些你从未意识到的肌肉疼痛，但其中很多疼痛是由于步行上山前往发射点所致。

sentence_translations.sentence: Flying a paraglider is a great sport.
sentence_translations.translation: 驾驶滑翔伞是一项很棒的运动。

sentence_translations.sentence: We hope to see you in the air with us this season!
sentence_translations.translation: 我们期待在这个季节看到你和我们一起翱翔天际！

parts.title: Passage 2
parts.article_title: How to prepare for an interview

paragraphs.text: Why prepare?
paragraphs.translation: 为什么要准备？

paragraphs.text: There are three main reasons.
paragraphs.translation: 主要有三个原因。

paragraphs.text: One: Although you can't guess every question you might be asked, if you are prepared you can tailor your answers to fit.
paragraphs.translation: 首先，尽管你无法猜测所有可能被问到的问题，但如果你有所准备，就可以调整自己的回答来适应具体情况。

paragraphs.text: Two: If you're well prepared, you will have more confidence and this will affect the way you come across.
paragraphs.translation: 第二：如果你准备充分，你会更有自信，而这会影响你给人留下的印象。

paragraphs.text: Three: Attitude matters. Prospective employers will choose a not-quite-perfect but willing candidate over a brilliant one who obviously isn't bothered.
paragraphs.translation:
第三：态度至关重要。
未来的雇主会选择一位并非完美但态度积极的应聘者，而不是一位才华横溢却显然漠不关心的人。

paragraphs.text: What to prepare?
paragraphs.translation: 该准备什么？

paragraphs.text: Find out about the organisation
paragraphs.translation: 了解该组织的情况

paragraphs.text: • Visit the website and read any materials that you have been sent. If nothing has been sent, phone the company to ask for any reading matter they may have.
paragraphs.translation:
访问网站并阅读你已收到的任何材料。
如果什么也没收到，就打电话给公司询问他们可能有的任何阅读资料。

paragraphs.text: • Talk to anyone you know who works there already.
paragraphs.translation: • 与你认识并已在该机构工作的人交谈。

paragraphs.text: Find out about the job
paragraphs.translation: 了解这份工作的内容

paragraphs.text: • Ask for a job description or specification. This will tell you the duties that go with the job.
paragraphs.translation:
• 索要一份职位描述或工作规范。
这会告诉你这份工作所涉及的职责。

paragraphs.text: • Talk to anyone you know who is familiar with the work you may be doing.
paragraphs.translation: • 与你认识的、熟悉你可能从事的工作的人交谈。

paragraphs.text: Find out what the employer is looking for
paragraphs.translation: 了解雇主在寻找什么样的人才

paragraphs.text: • Make a list of the skills specified in the job advertisement.
paragraphs.translation: • 列出工作广告中明确要求的技能。

paragraphs.text: • Think of examples to back up claims that you have these skills.
paragraphs.translation: • 想出实例来支持你拥有这些技能的说法。

paragraphs.text: You can then answer most of the questions that will come up, such as 'Tell me more about how you work in a team'.
paragraphs.translation: 这样一来，你就能回答大部分可能出现的问题，比如‘请详细说说你在团队中是如何工作的’。

paragraphs.text: Add in a few 'lessons learned' - what you did and how you might have done it better. You can also outline any voluntary work you have done for a charity, or any experience of paid work in an unrelated sector.
paragraphs.translation:
加入一些‘经验教训’——你做了什么以及你可能如何做得更好。
你还可以概述你为慈善机构所做的任何志愿工作，或者在任何不相关领域的有偿工作经历。

paragraphs.text: Preparing for other kinds of questions
paragraphs.translation: 准备其他类型的问题

paragraphs.text: Interviewers are also looking for someone who is likely to stay with the organisation and progress within it. Prepare to answer questions about your ambitions for the future.
paragraphs.translation:
面试官也在寻找那些可能长期留在组织内并逐步晋升的人。
准备好回答关于你未来抱负的问题。

paragraphs.text: You may also be asked to account for gaps in your career history. if you have any. Be positive and accentuate the learning or experience you gained during these periods.
paragraphs.translation:
你也可能会被要求解释职业生涯中的空档期。
如果有任何空档期，请保持积极态度，并强调你在这些时间段内获得的学识或经验。

paragraphs.text: Preparing your own questions
paragraphs.translation: 准备你自己的问题

paragraphs.text: • Do ask technical questions about software, systems and structures and how things are done.
paragraphs.translation: • 一定要问关于软件、系统、结构以及工作方式的技术性问题。

paragraphs.text: • Do ask about possibilities for training.
paragraphs.translation: • 一定要询问培训的可能性。

paragraphs.text: • Don't ask about salary unless you have been offered the job.
paragraphs.translation: • 除非你已经拿到这份工作，否则不要询问薪资。

paragraphs.text: When you've prepared as much as this, you've got a good chance of success.
paragraphs.translation: 当你准备得如此充分时，你就有很大的成功机会。

paragraphs.text: Good luck!
paragraphs.translation: 祝你好运！

paragraphs.text: Setting up your own business
paragraphs.translation: 创办自己的企业

paragraphs.text: Here are some ideas about how you should start:
paragraphs.translation: 以下是一些关于如何开始的建议：

paragraphs.text: Know your market
paragraphs.translation: 了解你的市场

paragraphs.text: So you know what you want to sell - the most important thing is that it should be something that people want to buy. Start by thinking about who your target customers are. Are they people who live locally? Are they a particular group of people?
paragraphs.translation:
因此，你知道自己想卖什么——最重要的是，它应该是人们想要购买的东西。
首先，思考你的目标客户是谁。
他们是居住在本地的人吗？
他们是特定的一群人吗？

paragraphs.text: Now look at your competitors. What is different about what you will be doing and how will you persuade people to come to you instead of going to someone who is already established?
paragraphs.translation:
现在来看看你的竞争对手。
你将要从事的工作有什么不同之处，以及你将如何说服人们选择你而非一个已经站稳脚跟的对手？

paragraphs.text: How will you reach the customers?
paragraphs.translation: 你将如何接触到客户？

paragraphs.text: Will you promote your product by phoning people, or visiting local traders, or advertising in magazines or online? will your delivery system be direct or through shops?
paragraphs.translation:
你会通过打电话给人们、拜访当地商家、在杂志或网络上做广告来推广你的产品吗？
你的配送系统会是直接送货还是通过商店进行？

paragraphs.text: How will your business work?
paragraphs.translation: 你的业务将如何运作？

paragraphs.text: Now think about what your business needs to succeed. Do you need to look for premises or can you work from home? Do you need to invest in manufacturing equipment to start with?
paragraphs.translation:
现在思考一下你的企业需要什么才能成功。
你是否需要寻找经营场所，还是可以在家工作？
你一开始是否需要投资购买生产设备？

paragraphs.text: Is the business something that you can do on your own, or if you get more work will you be looking to recruit staff? If so, what skills would they need?
paragraphs.translation:
这项业务是你自己就能完成的，还是说如果工作量增加，你会考虑招聘员工？
如果是这样，他们需要具备哪些技能？

paragraphs.text: Whether you're a sole operator or are looking to recruit a team, effective management is essential. The law regulates how companies are run and you need to set aside the time to see that this is done properly, in relation to issues like accounting, insurance and tax.
paragraphs.translation:
无论你是独自经营者，还是打算招募团队，有效的管理至关重要。
法律规范了公司的运营方式，你需要留出时间确保在会计、保险和税务等问题上依法妥善执行。

paragraphs.text: The money!
paragraphs.translation: 资金呢！

paragraphs.text: As you are working out the prices for your products, you need to make sure you build in all your costs. Remember you will probably need help from an accountant at least once a year, so build that in too, and do a forecast of how much money you think will flow in and out of the business.
paragraphs.translation:
在计算产品价格时，你需要确保将所有成本都纳入其中。
记住，你很可能至少需要每年请一次会计师帮忙，所以也要把这一点考虑进去，并预测你认为企业将有多少资金进出。

paragraphs.text: Look at what you expect to happen over the next three years - and work out what you need to do to break even, as well as the turnover that you hope to achieve to give you a profit. If you think you will need to find some funding to help get the business of the ground, how much will you need and who will you approach to get it?
paragraphs.translation:
审视你对未来三年内可能发生的情况的预期，并计算出为了实现收支平衡你需要做些什么，以及你希望达到的营业额，从而为你带来利润。
如果你认为需要找到一些资金来帮助启动业务，那么你需要多少资金，以及你会向谁寻求获取这些资金？

paragraphs.text: Your business plan
paragraphs.translation: 你的商业计划

paragraphs.text: Now write it all up and call it a business plan.
paragraphs.translation: 现在把所有内容整理成文，并将其称为商业计划。

parts.source_article_title: How to prepare for an interview

sentence_translations.sentence: Why prepare?
sentence_translations.translation: 为什么要准备？

sentence_translations.sentence: There are three main reasons.
sentence_translations.translation: 主要有三个原因。

sentence_translations.sentence: One: Although you can't guess every question you might be asked, if you are prepared you can tailor your answers to fit.
sentence_translations.translation: 首先，尽管你无法猜测所有可能被问到的问题，但如果你有所准备，就可以调整自己的回答来适应具体情况。

sentence_translations.sentence: Two: If you're well prepared, you will have more confidence and this will affect the way you come across.
sentence_translations.translation: 第二：如果你准备充分，你会更有自信，而这会影响你给人留下的印象。

sentence_translations.sentence: Three: Attitude matters.
sentence_translations.translation: 第三：态度至关重要。

sentence_translations.sentence: Prospective employers will choose a not-quite-perfect but willing candidate over a brilliant one who obviously isn't bothered.
sentence_translations.translation: 未来的雇主会选择一位并非完美但态度积极的应聘者，而不是一位才华横溢却显然漠不关心的人。

sentence_translations.sentence: What to prepare?
sentence_translations.translation: 该准备什么？

sentence_translations.sentence: Find out about the organisation
sentence_translations.translation: 了解该组织的情况

sentence_translations.sentence: Visit the website and read any materials that you have been sent.
sentence_translations.translation: 访问网站并阅读你已收到的任何材料。

sentence_translations.sentence: If nothing has been sent, phone the company to ask for any reading matter they may have.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果什么也没收到，就打电话给公司询问他们可能有的任何阅读资料。

sentence_translations.sentence: • Talk to anyone you know who works there already.
sentence_translations.translation: • 与你认识并已在该机构工作的人交谈。

sentence_translations.sentence: Find out about the job
sentence_translations.translation: 了解这份工作的内容

sentence_translations.sentence: • Ask for a job description or specification.
sentence_translations.translation: • 索要一份职位描述或工作规范。

sentence_translations.sentence: This will tell you the duties that go with the job.
sentence_translations.translation: 这会告诉你这份工作所涉及的职责。

sentence_translations.sentence: • Talk to anyone you know who is familiar with the work you may be doing.
sentence_translations.translation: • 与你认识的、熟悉你可能从事的工作的人交谈。

sentence_translations.sentence: Find out what the employer is looking for
sentence_translations.translation: 了解雇主在寻找什么样的人才

sentence_translations.sentence: • Make a list of the skills specified in the job advertisement.
sentence_translations.translation: • 列出工作广告中明确要求的技能。

sentence_translations.sentence: • Think of examples to back up claims that you have these skills.
sentence_translations.translation: • 想出实例来支持你拥有这些技能的说法。

sentence_translations.sentence: You can then answer most of the questions that will come up, such as 'Tell me more about how you work in a team'.
sentence_translations.translation: 这样一来，你就能回答大部分可能出现的问题，比如‘请详细说说你在团队中是如何工作的’。

sentence_translations.sentence: Add in a few 'lessons learned' - what you did and how you might have done it better.
sentence_translations.translation: 加入一些‘经验教训’——你做了什么以及你可能如何做得更好。

sentence_translations.sentence: You can also outline any voluntary work you have done for a charity, or any experience of paid work in an unrelated sector.
sentence_translations.translation: 你还可以概述你为慈善机构所做的任何志愿工作，或者在任何不相关领域的有偿工作经历。

sentence_translations.sentence: Preparing for other kinds of questions
sentence_translations.translation: 准备其他类型的问题

sentence_translations.sentence: Interviewers are also looking for someone who is likely to stay with the organisation and progress within it.
sentence_translations.translation: 面试官也在寻找那些可能长期留在组织内并逐步晋升的人。

sentence_translations.sentence: Prepare to answer questions about your ambitions for the future.
sentence_translations.translation: 准备好回答关于你未来抱负的问题。

sentence_translations.sentence: You may also be asked to account for gaps in your career history.
sentence_translations.translation: 你也可能会被要求解释职业生涯中的空档期。

sentence_translations.sentence: if you have any. Be positive and accentuate the learning or experience you gained during these periods.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果有任何空档期，请保持积极态度，并强调你在这些时间段内获得的学识或经验。

sentence_translations.sentence: Preparing your own questions
sentence_translations.translation: 准备你自己的问题

sentence_translations.sentence: • Do ask technical questions about software, systems and structures and how things are done.
sentence_translations.translation: • 一定要问关于软件、系统、结构以及工作方式的技术性问题。

sentence_translations.sentence: • Do ask about possibilities for training.
sentence_translations.translation: • 一定要询问培训的可能性。

sentence_translations.sentence: • Don't ask about salary unless you have been offered the job.
sentence_translations.translation: • 除非你已经拿到这份工作，否则不要询问薪资。

sentence_translations.sentence: When you've prepared as much as this, you've got a good chance of success.
sentence_translations.translation: 当你准备得如此充分时，你就有很大的成功机会。

sentence_translations.sentence: Good luck!
sentence_translations.translation: 祝你好运！

sentence_translations.sentence: Setting up your own business
sentence_translations.translation: 创办自己的企业

sentence_translations.sentence: Here are some ideas about how you should start:
sentence_translations.translation: 以下是一些关于如何开始的建议：

sentence_translations.sentence: Know your market
sentence_translations.translation: 了解你的市场

sentence_translations.sentence: So you know what you want to sell - the most important thing is that it should be something that people want to buy.
sentence_translations.translation: 因此，你知道自己想卖什么——最重要的是，它应该是人们想要购买的东西。

sentence_translations.sentence: Start by thinking about who your target customers are.
sentence_translations.translation: 首先，思考你的目标客户是谁。

sentence_translations.sentence: Are they people who live locally?
sentence_translations.translation: 他们是居住在本地的人吗？

sentence_translations.sentence: Are they a particular group of people?
sentence_translations.translation: 他们是特定的一群人吗？

sentence_translations.sentence: Now look at your competitors.
sentence_translations.translation: 现在来看看你的竞争对手。

sentence_translations.sentence: What is different about what you will be doing and how will you persuade people to come to you instead of going to someone who is already established?
sentence_translations.translation: 你将要从事的工作有什么不同之处，以及你将如何说服人们选择你而非一个已经站稳脚跟的对手？

sentence_translations.sentence: How will you reach the customers?
sentence_translations.translation: 你将如何接触到客户？

sentence_translations.sentence: Will you promote your product by phoning people, or visiting local traders, or advertising in magazines or online?
sentence_translations.translation: 你会通过打电话给人们、拜访当地商家、在杂志或网络上做广告来推广你的产品吗？

sentence_translations.sentence: will your delivery system be direct or through shops?
sentence_translations.translation: 你的配送系统会是直接送货还是通过商店进行？

sentence_translations.sentence: How will your business work?
sentence_translations.translation: 你的业务将如何运作？

sentence_translations.sentence: Now think about what your business needs to succeed.
sentence_translations.translation: 现在思考一下你的企业需要什么才能成功。

sentence_translations.sentence: Do you need to look for premises or can you work from home?
sentence_translations.translation: 你是否需要寻找经营场所，还是可以在家工作？

sentence_translations.sentence: Do you need to invest in manufacturing equipment to start with?
sentence_translations.translation: 你一开始是否需要投资购买生产设备？

sentence_translations.sentence: Is the business something that you can do on your own, or if you get more work will you be looking to recruit staff?
sentence_translations.translation: 这项业务是你自己就能完成的，还是说如果工作量增加，你会考虑招聘员工？

sentence_translations.sentence: If so, what skills would they need?
sentence_translations.translation: 如果是这样，他们需要具备哪些技能？

sentence_translations.sentence: Whether you're a sole operator or are looking to recruit a team, effective management is essential.
sentence_translations.translation: 无论你是独自经营者，还是打算招募团队，有效的管理至关重要。

sentence_translations.sentence: The law regulates how companies are run and you need to set aside the time to see that this is done properly, in relation to issues like accounting, insurance and tax.
sentence_translations.translation: 法律规范了公司的运营方式，你需要留出时间确保在会计、保险和税务等问题上依法妥善执行。

sentence_translations.sentence: The money!
sentence_translations.translation: 资金呢！

sentence_translations.sentence: As you are working out the prices for your products, you need to make sure you build in all your costs.
sentence_translations.translation: 在计算产品价格时，你需要确保将所有成本都纳入其中。

sentence_translations.sentence: Remember you will probably need help from an accountant at least once a year, so build that in too, and do a forecast of how much money you think will flow in and out of the business.
sentence_translations.translation: 记住，你很可能至少需要每年请一次会计师帮忙，所以也要把这一点考虑进去，并预测你认为企业将有多少资金进出。

sentence_translations.sentence: Look at what you expect to happen over the next three years - and work out what you need to do to break even, as well as the turnover that you hope to achieve to give you a profit.
sentence_translations.translation: 审视你对未来三年内可能发生的情况的预期，并计算出为了实现收支平衡你需要做些什么，以及你希望达到的营业额，从而为你带来利润。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you think you will need to find some funding to help get the business of the ground, how much will you need and who will you approach to get it?
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你认为需要找到一些资金来帮助启动业务，那么你需要多少资金，以及你会向谁寻求获取这些资金？

sentence_translations.sentence: Your business plan
sentence_translations.translation: 你的商业计划

sentence_translations.sentence: Now write it all up and call it a business plan.
sentence_translations.translation: 现在把所有内容整理成文，并将其称为商业计划。

paragraphs.text: With its wild stare, swift speed and secretive nature, the UK's brown hare is the rabbit's mysterious cousin. Even in these days of agricultural intensification, the hare is still to be seen in open countryside, but its numbers are falling.
paragraphs.translation:
凭借其狂野的眼神、敏捷的速度和隐秘的天性，英国的棕兔是兔子神秘的表亲。
即使在农业集约化的今天，野兔仍然可以在开阔的乡村看到，但它们的数量正在下降。

paragraphs.text: A

Like many herbivores, brown hares spend a relatively large amount of their time feeding. They prefer to do this in the dark, but when nights are short, their activities do spill into daylight hours. Wherever they live, hares appear to have a fondness for fields with a variety of vegetation, for example short as well as longer clumps of grasses. Studies have demonstrated that they benefit from uncultivated land and other unploughed areas on farms, such as field margins. Therefore, if farmers provided patches of woodland in areas of pasture as well as assorted crops in arable areas, there would be year-round shelter and food, and this could be the key to turning round the current decline in hare populations.
paragraphs.translation:
与许多食草动物一样，棕兔花费相对大量的时间觅食。
它们更喜欢在黑暗中觅食，但当夜晚较短时，它们的活动会延伸到白天。
无论生活在哪里，野兔似乎都喜欢植被多样的田野，例如既有短草也有较高的草丛。
研究表明，它们受益于未开垦的土地和农场中其他未耕种的区域，比如田埂边。
因此，如果农民在牧区提供小块林地，并在可耕地区种植多种作物，就会有全年的庇护所和食物，这可能是扭转当前野兔数量下降的关键。
像许多食草动物一样，棕色野兔花费相对较多的时间进食。
它们更喜欢在黑暗中进食，但当夜晚较短时，它们的行为确实会延续到白天。
无论生活在哪里，野兔似乎偏爱植被多样的田地，例如既有短草也有较长草丛的草地。
研究表明，它们受益于农场中的未耕地和其他未翻耕的区域，比如田边地带。
因此，如果农民在牧场区域提供小块林地，并在可耕地种植多样作物，野兔将拥有全年的庇护所和食物，这可能是扭转当前野兔种群数量下降的关键。
它们更喜欢在黑暗中进食，但当夜晚短暂的时候，它们的活动确实会延续到白天。
无论生活在何处，野兔似乎都偏爱植被多样的田地，例如既有短草也有较长草丛的草地。
研究表明，它们从农场中的未耕地和其他未耕作区域（例如田埂边缘）获益。
因此，如果农民在牧场地区提供小块林地，并在可耕地地区提供多样化的作物，全年都会有遮蔽物和食物，这可能是扭转当前野兔数量下降的关键。

paragraphs.text: B

Brown hares have a number of physical adaptations that enable them to survive in open countryside. They have exceptionally large ears that move independently, so that a range of sounds can be pinpointed accurately. Positioned high up on their heads, the hares' large golden eyes give them 360°vision, making it hard to take a hare by surprise. Compared to mammals of a similar size, hares have a greatly enlarged heart and a higher volume of blood in their bodies, and this allows for superior speed and stamina. In addition, their legs are longer than those of a rabbit, enabling hares to run more like a dog and reach speeds of up to 70 kph.
paragraphs.translation:
棕色野兔拥有许多身体上的适应性特征，使它们能够在开阔乡村中生存。
它们的耳朵异常大且能独立活动，因此可以精确定位各种声音。
野兔的的金色大眼睛高高位于头部两侧，赋予它们360度的视野，使它们很难被偷袭。
与类似大小的哺乳动物相比，野兔的心脏显著增大，体内血量更多，这使它们拥有卓越的速度和耐力。
此外，它们的腿比兔子更长，使野兔能像狗一样奔跑，并达到高达每小时70公里的速度。

paragraphs.text: C

Brown hares have unusual lifestyles for their large size, breeding from a young age and producing many leverets (babies). There are about three litters of up to four leverets every year. Both males and females are able to breed at about seven months old, but they have to be quick because they seldom live for more than two years. The breeding season runs from January to October, and by late February most females are pregnant or giving birth to their first litter of the year. So it seems strange, therefore, that it is in March, when the breeding season is already underway, that hares seemingly go mad: boxing, dancing, running and fighting. This has given rise to the age-old reference to 'mad March hares'. In fact, boxing occurs throughout the breeding season, but people tend to see this behaviour more often in March. This is because in the succeeding months, dusk - the time when hares are most active - is later, when fewer people are about. Crops and vegetation are also taller, hiding the hares from view. Though it is often thought that they are males fighting over females, boxing hares are usually females fighting off males. Hares are mostly solitary, but a female fights off a series of males until she is ready to mate. This occurs several times through the breeding season because, as soon as the female has given birth, she will be ready to mate again.
paragraphs.translation:
棕色野兔因其体型较大而拥有不同寻常的生活方式，它们从幼年就开始繁殖，并产下许多幼兔。
每年大约会有三窝幼兔，每窝最多四只。
雄性和雌性野兔大约在七个月大时就能繁殖，但它们必须抓紧时间，因为它们的寿命很少超过两年。
繁殖季节从一月持续到十月，到二月下旬，大多数雌兔已经怀孕或正在产下当年的第一窝幼兔。
因此，奇怪的是，在三月这个繁殖季节已经开始的时候，野兔似乎变得疯狂起来：打斗、跳跃、奔跑和撕咬。
这引发了古老的谚语“疯狂的三月野兔”。
事实上，打斗行为在整个繁殖季节都会发生，但人们往往在三月更常看到这种行为。
这是因为在接下来的月份里，黄昏——野兔最活跃的时间——来得更晚，此时外出的人更少。
农作物和植被也长得更高，遮挡了野兔的身影。
尽管人们通常认为打斗的是雄兔在争夺雌兔，但实际打斗的野兔通常是雌兔在击退雄兔。
野兔大多独居，但雌兔会击退一连串的雄兔，直到她准备好交配。
这种情况在繁殖季节会发生多次，因为雌兔一旦产下幼崽，她就会准备好再次交配。
棕色野兔体型较大，却有着不同寻常的生活方式，它们从小就开始繁殖，并且产下许多幼兔。

This lack of family contact may seem harsh to us, but it is a strategy that draws less attention from predators. Research has shown that hares' milk is extremely rich and fatty, so a little goes a long way. In order to produce such nutritious milk, females need a high-quality, high-calorie diet. Hares are selective feeders at the best of times: unlike many herbivores, they can't sit around waiting to digest low-quality food - they need high-energy herbs and other leaves in order to sprint. sentence_translations.sentence: With its wild stare, swift speed and secretive nature, the UK's brown hare is the rabbit's mysterious cousin.
sentence_translations.translation: 凭借其狂野的眼神、敏捷的速度和隐秘的天性，英国的棕兔是兔子神秘的表亲。

sentence_translations.sentence: Even in these days of agricultural intensification, the hare is still to be seen in open countryside, but its numbers are falling.
sentence_translations.translation: 即使在农业集约化的今天，野兔仍然可以在开阔的乡村看到，但它们的数量正在下降。

sentence_translations.sentence: Like many herbivores, brown hares spend a relatively large amount of their time feeding.
sentence_translations.translation: 与许多食草动物一样，棕兔花费相对大量的时间觅食。

sentence_translations.sentence: They prefer to do this in the dark, but when nights are short, their activities do spill into daylight hours.
sentence_translations.translation: 它们更喜欢在黑暗中觅食，但当夜晚较短时，它们的活动会延伸到白天。

sentence_translations.sentence: Wherever they live, hares appear to have a fondness for fields with a variety of vegetation, for example short as well as longer clumps of grasses.
sentence_translations.translation: 无论生活在哪里，野兔似乎都喜欢植被多样的田野，例如既有短草也有较高的草丛。

sentence_translations.sentence: Studies have demonstrated that they benefit from uncultivated land and other unploughed areas on farms, such as field margins.
sentence_translations.translation: 研究表明，它们受益于未开垦的土地和农场中其他未耕种的区域，比如田埂边。

sentence_translations.sentence: Therefore, if farmers provided patches of woodland in areas of pasture as well as assorted crops in arable areas, there would be year-round shelter and food, and this could be the key to turning round the current decline in hare populations.
sentence_translations.translation: 因此，如果农民在牧区提供小块林地，并在可耕地区种植多种作物，就会有全年的庇护所和食物，这可能是扭转当前野兔数量下降的关键。

sentence_translations.sentence: Brown hares have a number of physical adaptations that enable them to survive in open countryside.
sentence_translations.translation: 棕色野兔拥有许多身体上的适应性特征，使它们能够在开阔乡村中生存。

sentence_translations.sentence: They have exceptionally large ears that move independently, so that a range of sounds can be pinpointed accurately.
sentence_translations.translation: 它们的耳朵异常大且能独立活动，因此可以精确定位各种声音。

sentence_translations.sentence: Positioned high up on their heads, the hares' large golden eyes give them 360° vision, making it hard to take a hare by surprise.
sentence_translations.translation: 野兔的的金色大眼睛高高位于头部两侧，赋予它们360度的视野，使它们很难被偷袭。

sentence_translations.sentence: Compared to mammals of a similar size, hares have a greatly enlarged heart and a higher volume of blood in their bodies, and this allows for superior speed and stamina.
sentence_translations.translation: 与类似大小的哺乳动物相比，野兔的心脏显著增大，体内血量更多，这使它们拥有卓越的速度和耐力。

sentence_translations.sentence: In addition, their legs are longer than those of a rabbit, enabling hares to run more like a dog and reach speeds of up to 70 kph.
sentence_translations.translation: 此外，它们的腿比兔子更长，使野兔能像狗一样奔跑，并达到高达每小时70公里的速度。

sentence_translations.sentence: Brown hares have unusual lifestyles for their large size, breeding from a young age and producing many leverets (babies).
sentence_translations.translation: 棕色野兔因其体型较大而拥有不同寻常的生活方式，它们从幼年就开始繁殖，并产下许多幼兔。

sentence_translations.sentence: There are about three litters of up to four leverets every year.
sentence_translations.translation: 每年大约会有三窝幼兔，每窝最多四只。

sentence_translations.sentence: Both males and females are able to breed at about seven months old, but they have to be quick because they seldom live for more than two years.
sentence_translations.translation: 雄性和雌性野兔大约在七个月大时就能繁殖，但它们必须抓紧时间，因为它们的寿命很少超过两年。

sentence_translations.sentence: The breeding season runs from January to October, and by late February most females are pregnant or giving birth to their first litter of the year.
sentence_translations.translation: 繁殖季节从一月持续到十月，到二月下旬，大多数雌兔已经怀孕或正在产下当年的第一窝幼兔。

sentence_translations.sentence: So it seems strange, therefore, that it is in March, when the breeding season is already underway, that hares seemingly go mad: boxing, dancing, running and fighting.
sentence_translations.translation: 因此，奇怪的是，在三月这个繁殖季节已经开始的时候，野兔似乎变得疯狂起来：打斗、跳跃、奔跑和撕咬。

sentence_translations.sentence: This has given rise to the age-old reference to 'mad March hares'.
sentence_translations.translation: 这引发了古老的谚语“疯狂的三月野兔”。

sentence_translations.sentence: In fact, boxing occurs throughout the breeding season, but people tend to see this behaviour more often in March.
sentence_translations.translation: 事实上，打斗行为在整个繁殖季节都会发生，但人们往往在三月更常看到这种行为。

sentence_translations.sentence: This is because in the succeeding months, dusk - the time when hares are most active - is later, when fewer people are about.
sentence_translations.translation: 这是因为在接下来的月份里，黄昏——野兔最活跃的时间——来得更晚，此时外出的人更少。

sentence_translations.sentence: Crops and vegetation are also taller, hiding the hares from view.
sentence_translations.translation: 农作物和植被也长得更高，遮挡了野兔的身影。

sentence_translations.sentence: Though it is often thought that they are males fighting over females, boxing hares are usually females fighting off males.
sentence_translations.translation: 尽管人们通常认为打斗的是雄兔在争夺雌兔，但实际打斗的野兔通常是雌兔在击退雄兔。

sentence_translations.sentence: Hares are mostly solitary, but a female fights off a series of males until she is ready to mate.
sentence_translations.translation: 野兔大多独居，但雌兔会击退一连串的雄兔，直到她准备好交配。

sentence_translations.sentence: This occurs several times through the breeding season because, as soon as the female has given birth, she will be ready to mate again.
sentence_translations.translation: 这种情况在繁殖季节会发生多次，因为雌兔一旦产下幼崽，她就会准备好再次交配。

sentence_translations.sentence: But how can females manage to do this while simultaneously feeding themselves and rearing their young?
sentence_translations.translation: 但是雌性野兔如何能够在同时喂养自己和抚养幼崽的情况下做到这一点呢？

sentence_translations.sentence: The reason is that hares have evolved such self-sufficient young.
sentence_translations.translation: 原因是野兔进化出了如此自给自足的幼崽。

sentence_translations.sentence: Unlike baby rabbits, leverets are born furry and mobile.
sentence_translations.translation: 与幼兔不同，小野兔出生时就有毛发且能活动。

sentence_translations.sentence: They weigh about 100 g at birth and are immediately left to their own devices by their mothers.
sentence_translations.translation: 它们出生时体重约100克，并立即被母亲弃之不顾，任其自生自灭。

sentence_translations.sentence: A few days later, the members of the litter creep away to create their own individual resting places, known as 'forms'.
sentence_translations.translation: 几天后，同窝的幼崽们悄悄离开，各自建造自己单独的休息场所，称为“巢穴”。

sentence_translations.sentence: Incredibly, their mother visits them only once every 24 hours and, even then, she only suckles them for a maximum of five minutes each.
sentence_translations.translation: 令人难以置信的是，它们的母亲每24小时只探望它们一次，即使如此，每次哺乳时间最多也只有五分钟。

sentence_translations.sentence: This lack of family contact may seem harsh to us, but it is a strategy that draws less attention from predators.
sentence_translations.translation: 这种缺乏家庭联系的方式对我们来说似乎很残酷，但这是一种减少吸引捕食者注意的策略。

sentence_translations.sentence: At the tender age of two weeks, leverets start to feed themselves, while still drinking their mother's milk.
sentence_translations.translation: 在仅仅两周大的时候，小野兔就开始自己觅食，同时仍喝母亲的奶。

sentence_translations.sentence: They grow swiftly and are fully weaned at four weeks, reaching adult weight at about six months.
sentence_translations.translation: 它们生长迅速，四周大时完全断奶，大约六个月时达到成年体重。

sentence_translations.sentence: Research has shown that hares' milk is extremely rich and fatty, so a little goes a long way.
sentence_translations.translation: 研究表明，野兔的乳汁极其丰富且富含脂肪，因此少量就能提供充足能量。

sentence_translations.sentence: In order to produce such nutritious milk, females need a high-quality, high-calorie diet.
sentence_translations.translation: 为了产出如此营养的乳汁，雌性野兔需要高质量、高热量的饮食。

sentence_translations.sentence: Hares are selective feeders at the best of times: unlike many herbivores, they can't sit around waiting to digest low-quality food - they need high-energy herbs and other leaves in order to sprint.
sentence_translations.translation: 即使在最佳时期，野兔也是选择性觅食者：与许多草食动物不同，它们不能坐等消化低质量食物——它们需要高能量的草本植物和其他叶子来奔跑。
